To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
non-systematic coded OFDM is superior to systematic coded OFDM, which in turn is superior to OFDM with CP.

the proposed non-systematic coded OFDM by unique word prefix (UW) outperforms the conventional CP-OFDM scheme in the presence of AWGN and frequency selective fading, and that the UW-OFDM schemes are robust against timing and frequency offsets.

non-systematic complex number RS coded UW-OFDMA outperforms CP-OFDMA in terms of bit error ratio ( BER) performance, spectral properties, and computational complexity, and that the performance of the non-systematic complex RS coded UW- OFDMA is superior to that of the systematic complex RS coded UW -OFDMA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and performance of a non-systematic coded OFDM scheme with UWs, which is a very interesting candidate for future wireless communications systems.
the design of novel UW-OFDM systems with improved performance and reduced computational complexity.
the introduction and investigation of a novel coding scheme for UW-OFDM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
non-systematic coded OFDM with UWs is a promising alternative to CP-OFDMA.

non-systematic coded OFDM with UWs is superior to CP-OFDMA, systematic coded OFDM with CPs, as well as to non-systematic coded CP-OFDMA in terms of spectral efficiency, robustness, and BER performance.
non-systematic coded OFDM with UWs is superior in terms of spectral efficiency and robustness against frequency selectivity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
non-systematic coded OFDM with UWs is the best choice for the transmission of data with low to moderate complexity.
the proposed non-systematic complex number RS coded UW-OFMD outperforms CP-OFDM by a considerable margin, especially in the presence of frequency selective fading.
non-systematic coded OFDM is the best solution in terms of spectral properties and BER performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
non-systematic complex number RS coded UW-OFMD outperforms CP-OFDM, and is superior to systematic complex number RS coded OFDM.
the non-systematic coded OFDM concept can be applied to any kind of OFDM system.
